Vocabualize Deutsch

Learn the words around you.

Vocabualize helps you collect and remember vocabulary. Type a word or scan what you see, get a translation and a photo, and practice at the right moment.

Soon on Google Play
  • Add words your way: type them or scan an object with the camera.
  • Translation and photos are suggested automatically.
  • Practice with spaced repetition, so you review each word right before you would forget it.
  • Streaks and reminders keep you going.
  • Works offline, no account needed. Sign in with Google only if you want to sync between devices.

Learn English, German, Spanish, French or Polish. No ads, no tracking.
